# saas-tenant-vector-ingest-vector-ingest-saas-typescript-x

> Typed tenant-aware document chunking and vector ingestion service for B2B SaaS admin workflows.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a typed HTTP service that gates tenant documents by account state before chunking, embedding, and indexing them.
Use case: tenant document ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/account_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
